mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, it is 58 degrees with overcast skies at the high school, under the third quarter moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 58 degrees, and we are expecting rain.

The city has officially welcomed Liz Gay as the new EMS Deputy Chief of Administration. She brings a strong background in public safety leadership and emergency operations to our community. Also, a reminder that the city contracts with Pellitteri for all refuse and recycling needs, so be sure to check their app for schedules.
Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is packed with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.
In a recent report, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I on October 25 after he was discovered passed out in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today is the perfect time to try the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
